description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
The Myr Battlesphere token enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Myr tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Urza to make infinite copies of any artifacts you control.
